text:
Alex: Heads-up: ran a long-tail perf stab on the paged-attn path with 8k contexts on a 4xA100 pool. seeing intermittent OOM spikes and ~12-18% latency regression on tail buckets.
Marina: ugh. kernel selection fallback? what model/quant? :thinking_face: 
Alex: fp16 q4_0, compiled with the new kernel-picker change from last deploy (hash a1b2c3). fallback to slower kernel frequently when sequence > 4096.
Sanjay: ran profiler. looks like workspace sizing is being pessimistically oversubscribed by the allocator when kv-cache churn is high. sample from rvprof: 
```
[rvprof] model: redwood-v2-8k q4_0
alloc_workspace peak=12.4GB (expected 9.1GB)
kv_cache churn=430MB/s
batch_size=6 -> avg latency 210ms tail99 480ms
fallback_kernel=attention_v2_slow (30% of requests)
```
Luis: noted that kv_eviction is happening per-request instead of batched, causing compaction thrashing. compaction_costs spike when block reuse < 0.6.
Emma: could be the new eviction heuristic's hysteresis is too small. it compacts aggressively on small pressure and then re-fills, creating cycles.
Marina: idea: add a lightweight probe that simulates small batches to estimate true per-model workspace requirement before committing big kernels. call it ws-probe. if probe shows < threshold, pick compact kernels or enable eager reuse.
Alex: love that. probe would be cheap (one short prefix run) and could run at route start. what's the overhead? 
Sanjay: negligible if we make it async and cache results for 30s. probe logic pseudocode: 
```
probe = run_short_prefix(model, seq=128)
measure workspace_needed
if workspace_needed < layout.threshold:
  choose smaller-block allocator + reuse_policy=aggressive
else:
  choose high-throughput kernel
```
Luis: also propose increasing compaction hysteresis and switching compaction to incremental pass (spread over N requests) to avoid big pauses.
Marina: another knob: tune block size from 64->96 bytes for hot blocks to reduce fragmentation for long sequences. but that might increase wasted space for tiny tokens. need perf matrix.
Alex: agree. let's do a small matrix: block_size in {64,80,96}, reuse_threshold in {0.5,0.7,0.9}, compaction_hysteresis in {0.05,0.15,0.3}. run by traffic replay for 1 hour each and capture tail latencies + peak mem.
Emma: I'll wire the experiment harness. can we also snapshot kernel-selection trace so we can correlate fallback count? CI-Bot: experiment job queued: exp/kv-ws-probe-2004127890 (ETA ~2h).
Sanjay: for immediate mitigation, flip allocator to conservative mode on routes with high kv churn: enable eager buffer reuse (time-based aging=2s) and cap per-request workspace to 75% of peak measured. should reduce OOM spikes.
Alex: go ahead with mitigation on canary routes only for now. @Luis can you handle rollout? @Marina please add telemetry for probe hits/misses + per-route fallback rate.
Luis: on it, will run canary in us-central-1 for 24h.
Marina: I'll add dashboards: ws_probe.success_rate, fallback_kernel.percent, kv_eviction.rate, compaction.time_p95.
Emma: reminder to include changelog entry about probe and allocator conservative toggle.
Alex: thanks all. follow-up: we'll review experiment results tomorrow 10am. if the probe reduces fallbacks by >60% and mem peak drops >15% we promote change. :thumbsup:
